people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them;
translations.bsb: After King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim liberty, the word came to Jeremiah from the LORD
translations.kjv: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty
translations.asv: The word that came unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people that were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
